# Changelog

All notable changes to this project are documented in this file. The format follows
[Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/); versions are `major.minor.micro`
and every release is tagged `vX.Y.Z`.

## [0.2.0] - 2026-08-20

### Added

- enforce model context windows ([#3](https://github.com/kskadart/open-harness-router/pull/3))

### Fixed

- stop leaking credentials to third parties ([#5](https://github.com/kskadart/open-harness-router/pull/5))
